pages.title: Integer Ring
pages.text: Every natural number paired with its mirror image below zero, closed under addition, subtraction and multiplication. The ring has a satisfying symmetry: turn it over and every number becomes its negative. Being a ring, you can add or multiply any two elements and never fall out of it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Subtraction kept breaking the natural numbers; three minus five had nowhere to go. Feeding an antimatter pellet into the engine alongside a natural lattice gave each number an opposite, the way antimatter gives each particle one.
